info.title: Smartscan Async
info.description:
Smartscan Async lets you submit a document for processing and fetch the results later. It suits large documents, and it's the only way to use the ULTRA tier. Create a transaction, poll its status, then fetch the results.

**Hosts:** `api.prod.ssn.visma.ai` for production and `api.stag.ssn.visma.ai` for staging.

**Authentication:** send your project token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See [Authentication](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/authentication/).

**Errors:** a failed call returns an HTTP error status with a JSON body that holds `code`, `message` and `details`.

**Guides:** [Smartscan Async](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/smartscan-async/getting-started/), the [feature list](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/smartscan-async/features/) and [limits and rate limits](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/rate-limit/).

tags.name: TransactionService
tags.description: Create transactions, poll their status, fetch and correct their results, and delete them.

delete.summary: Delete all transactions with a tag.
delete.description:
Deletes every transaction in your project that was created with this tag, with its
document, results and feedback. Deletion runs in the background, as with
DELETE /v1/transactions/{id}.

Returns 404 when no transaction in your project has the tag.

parameters.name: tagName
parameters.description:
The tag, as set in tags when the transactions were created. URL-encode it if it holds
characters that aren't allowed in a URL path.

delete.description:
Deletes the transaction with its document, results and feedback. Refer to the
transaction by its ID in the path, or call DELETE /v1/transactions with the customId
query parameter.

Deletion runs in the background. A 200 response means the request was accepted, and the
data is removed shortly afterwards. Once it's removed, the custom ID can be used again.

Returns 404 when the transaction doesn't exist in your project, and 400 when neither a
transaction ID nor a custom ID is given.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The transaction ID, as returned when the transaction was created. Takes precedence over
customId when both are set.

parameters.name: customId
parameters.description:
The custom ID you set when creating the transaction. Used only when no transaction ID
is given, so send it to DELETE /v1/transactions.

post.description:
Submits a document for processing and returns right away with the transaction ID, plus
your custom ID if you set one. Poll GET /v1/transactions/{id}/status until the status is
DONE, PARTIAL or FAILED, then fetch the results with GET /v1/transactions/{id}/results.

Returns 400 when the document or the features are missing, when a feature name is
unknown, or when the document can't be downloaded from its URL. Returns 409 when the
custom ID is already used in your project.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body for creating a transaction.

get.summary: Get the results of a transaction.
get.description:
Returns the extracted data once processing has finished. Refer to the transaction by
its ID in the path, or call GET /v1/transactions/results with the customId query
parameter.

An existing transaction always returns 200, whatever its status. While it's CREATED or
RUNNING, the response holds only id and customId. When it FAILED, the response holds
errorMessage and no annotations. When it's PARTIAL, the response holds the annotations
of the features that succeeded, and errorMessage.

The candidates of field features are filtered. By default you get at most one candidate
per feature, and only at confidence level HIGH or above. Set minConfidence and
maxResults to get more.

Returns 404 when the transaction doesn't exist in your project, and 400 when neither a
transaction ID nor a custom ID is given.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The transaction ID, as returned when the transaction was created. Takes precedence over
customId when both are set.

parameters.name: customId
parameters.description:
The custom ID you set when creating the transaction. Used only when no transaction ID
is given, so send it to GET /v1/transactions/results.

parameters.name: minConfidence
parameters.description:
The lowest confidence level to return. Defaults to HIGH. Candidates below it are left
out, and so is a field feature with no candidate left. Applies to field features such as
TOTAL_INCL_VAT and IBAN, but not to KSEF, purchase lines, VAT distribution, answers, QR
codes or text.

 - UNKNOWN: No level. As `minConfidence`, it means the default, HIGH.
 - VERIFIED: The consistency checks of the VERIFIED feature confirmed or corrected the value.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of candidates per field feature. Defaults to 1.

put.summary: Send corrected results for a transaction.
put.description:
[NOT WORKING] The custom ID form, PUT /v1/transactions/results, ignores the request body,
so it returns success but saves nothing. Use PUT /v1/transactions/{id}/results.

Saves your corrected annotations as feedback, for improving the models. Send them once
the transaction is DONE or PARTIAL. Before that, or after it FAILED, the call returns 400
(FAILED_PRECONDITION). Each call with annotations replaces the feedback sent before.

Returns 404 when the transaction doesn't exist in your project.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The transaction ID. Send it in the path, with PUT /v1/transactions/{id}/results.

parameters.name: customId
parameters.description:
[NOT WORKING] Identifying the transaction by custom ID doesn't work here.
PUT /v1/transactions/results ignores the request body, so it returns success but saves
nothing. Use PUT /v1/transactions/{id}/results, where the ID in the path decides.

get.summary: Get the status of a transaction.
get.description:
Returns the processing status: CREATED, RUNNING, DONE, PARTIAL or FAILED. DONE, PARTIAL
and FAILED are final, so stop polling and fetch the results. Refer to the transaction by
its ID in the path, or call GET /v1/transactions/status with the customId query
parameter.

Returns 404 when the transaction doesn't exist in your project, and 400 when neither a
transaction ID nor a custom ID is given.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The transaction ID, as returned when the transaction was created. Takes precedence over
customId when both are set.

parameters.name: customId
parameters.description:
The custom ID you set when creating the transaction. Used only when no transaction ID
is given, so send it to GET /v1/transactions/status.

BlockBlockType.description:
Type of a block (text, image etc) as identified by OCR.

 - UNKNOWN: Unknown block type.
 - TEXT: Regular text block.
 - TABLE: Table block.
 - PICTURE: Image block.
 - RULER: Horizontal/vertical line box.
 - BARCODE: Barcode block.

ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence levels, from lowest to highest. The levels are designed to give
stable results across model upgrades.

 - UNKNOWN: No level. As `minConfidence`, it means the default, HIGH.
 - VERIFIED: The consistency checks of the VERIFIED feature confirmed or corrected the value.

DetectedBreakBreakType.description:
Enum to denote the type of break found. New line, space etc.

 - UNKNOWN: Unknown break label type.
 - SPACE: Regular space.
 - SURE_SPACE: Sure space (very wide).
 - EOL_SURE_SPACE: Line-wrapping break.
 - HYPHEN: End-line hyphen that is not present in text; does not co-occur with
`SPACE` or `LINE_BREAK`.
 - LINE_BREAK: Line break that ends a paragraph.

isPrefix.description: True if break prepends the element.

TextAnnotationDetectedBreak.description: Detected start or end of a structural component.

languageCode.description:
The BCP-47 language code, such as "en-US" or "sr-Latn". For more
information, see
http://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/#Unicode_locale_identifier.

TextAnnotationDetectedLanguage.description: Detected language for a structural component.

detectedLanguages.description: A list of detected languages together with confidence.

detectedBreak.description: Detected start or end of a text segment.

TextAnnotationTextProperty.description: Additional information detected on the structural component.

customId.description:
[NOT WORKING] Identifying the transaction by custom ID doesn't work here.
PUT /v1/transactions/results ignores the request body, so it returns success but saves
nothing. Use PUT /v1/transactions/{id}/results, where the ID in the path decides.

annotations.description:
Your corrected results, in the same format as the annotations returned by
GET /v1/transactions/{id}/results. Each call with annotations replaces the feedback sent
before.

feature.description: The feature these results belong to, for example TOTAL_INCL_VAT.

candidates.description:
Candidates for a field feature, such as TOTAL_INCL_VAT or IBAN: at most maxResults of
them, at or above minConfidence, without their confidence value. corrected is only set at
the VERIFIED level. For KSEF, the one candidate holds the KSeF number.

purchaseLineCandidates.description:
[DEPRECATED] Purchase lines in the simple form: one entry per line, each field holding a
single string, the value of the first candidate in purchaseLinesDetails. Kept for
existing integrations. New fields, such as productType, are only added to
purchaseLinesDetails, so use that instead.

answerCandidates.description: Answers to the questions sent with the transaction, for the QA feature.

textAnnotation.description:
The document's text and layout, for the TEXT_ANNOTATION feature: the full text, and the
pages broken down into blocks, paragraphs, words and symbols with their positions.

pageTexts.description: The plain text of each page, for the PAGE_TEXTS feature. pageRef numbers the pages from 1.

vatDistributionCandidates.description:
[DEPRECATED] VAT distribution in the simple form, each field holding a single string.
percentage, amount, exclVat and inclVat hold the first candidate's value of percentage,
totalVat, totalExclVat and totalInclVat in vatDistributionDetails. Kept for existing
integrations, so use vatDistributionDetails instead.

qrCodes.description: QR codes found in the document, for the QR_CODES feature.

swissQrBills.description: Swiss QR bills found in the document, for the SWISS_QR_BILLS feature.

purchaseLinesDetails.description:
Purchase lines in the detailed form, for the PURCHASE_LINES feature: one entry per line,
each field holding a list of candidates with their confidence levels. With PRODUCT_TYPES,
each line also holds productType suggestions.

vatDistributionDetails.description:
VAT distribution in the detailed form, for the VAT_DISTRIBUTION feature: each field holds
a list of candidates with their confidence levels. The candidates come without
confidence values, bounding boxes or model metadata.

structuredAddress.description:
The address split into street, postal code, city, country and country code, for the
SUPPLIER_ADDRESS and RECEIVER_ADDRESS features.

asynctonv1Annotation.description: The results of one feature. Only the fields that belong to the feature are set.

question.description: The question, as sent in the request.

confidence.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Answers don't have a confidence yet, so this is always empty.

modelMetadata.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Answers don't name a model yet, so this is always empty.

pageRef.description:
The page the answer comes from, starting at 1. It's 1 when Smartscan reads the
first and last page together (see `documentMetadata.pageCount`).

typeAnswerCandidate.description: An answer to one of the questions in the request.

property.description: Additional information detected for the block.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs in the block, if it's a text block.

blockType.description: Detected block type (text, image etc) for this block.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results on the block. Range [0, 1].

vertices.description: The four points, in pixel coordinates.

normalizedVertices.description:
The same four points relative to the page size, from 0 to 1, so you can place an
overlay without knowing the size of the image.

typeBoundingPoly.description:
A box on the page, for example around the text of a candidate. Its four points are
ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left. When the box is rotated,
the order follows the text as it's read in its natural orientation, so the first
point is always the top-left corner of the text.

value.description:
The normalized value, for example "2019-01-01" for a date. Each field of the
response describes the format of its values.

text.description: The text as written on the document, for example "1. Jan". Useful for overlays.

pageRef.description: The page the candidate was found on, starting at 1.

corrected.description:
Only set on VERIFIED candidates: true when the consistency checks changed the
value, and false when they confirmed it.

typeCandidate.description:
A candidate value for a field, with its confidence and where it was found. In a
list of candidates, the most confident one comes first.

typeCandidateType.description: The kind of candidate. Not every candidate has one.

value.description: A confidence score. Most responses leave it out and return only the level.

typeConfidence.description: How confident Smartscan is in a candidate.

typeModelSpec.description: The model that produced a candidate.

x.description: The x coordinate, relative to the page width.

y.description: The y coordinate, relative to the page height.

typeNormalizedVertex.description: A point on the page, relative to the page size. Both coordinates range from 0 to 1.

property.description: Additional information detected on the page.

blocks.description: List of blocks of text, images etc on this page.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results on the page. Range [0, 1].

typePageText.description: The text of one page, returned for the PAGE_TEXTS feature.

property.description: Additional information detected for the paragraph.

words.description: List of words in this paragraph.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the paragraph. Range [0, 1].

typeParagraph.description: Structural unit of text representing a number of words in certain order.

pageRef.description: The page the line was found on, starting at 1.

code.description:
Candidates for the product code, product number or SKU that the supplier uses for
the item.

description.description:
Candidates for the description of the line, typically the name of a product or the
delivered service.

itemNumber.description: Candidates for the row number, position or ID of the line, if the document states one.

unit.description: Candidates for the unit of the quantity, for example "pieces", "kg" or "lb".

totalDiscount.description: Candidates for the total discount of the line.

percentageDiscount.description: Candidates for the discount rate of the line, as a percentage.

totalInclVat.description: Candidates for the line total including VAT.

totalExclVat.description: Candidates for the line total excluding VAT.

totalVat.description: Candidates for the VAT amount of the line.

percentageVat.description: Candidates for the VAT rate of the line, as a percentage, for example "25.0".

unitPriceInclVat.description: Candidates for the price of one unit, including VAT.

unitPriceExclVat.description: Candidates for the price of one unit, excluding VAT.

total.description:
Candidates for the line total as stated on the line, usually the rightmost amount.
Documents often don't say whether it includes VAT.

unitPrice.description:
Candidates for the price of one unit as stated on the line. Documents often don't
say whether it includes VAT.

productType.description:
Product type candidates for the line, classified from its description. Returned for
the PRODUCT_TYPES feature.

kind.description: Candidates for what the line charges for, for example "item", "freight" or "discount".

typePurchaseLine.description: A purchase line, with a list of candidates for each field.

pageRef.description: The page the line was found on, starting at 1.

code.description: The product code, product number or SKU that the supplier uses for the item.

description.description: The description of the line, typically the name of a product or the delivered service.

itemNumber.description: The row number, position or ID of the line, if the document states one.

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, for example "pieces", "kg" or "lb".

totalDiscount.description: The total discount of the line.

percentageDiscount.description: The discount rate of the line, as a percentage.

totalVat.description: The VAT amount of the line.

percentageVat.description: The VAT rate of the line, as a percentage, for example "25.0".

unitPriceInclVat.description: The price of one unit, including VAT.

unitPriceExclVat.description: The price of one unit, excluding VAT.

total.description:
The line total as stated on the line, usually the rightmost amount. Documents
often don't say whether it includes VAT.

unitPrice.description:
The price of one unit as stated on the line. Documents often don't say whether
it includes VAT.

productType.description:
The product type of the line in the older format. For product types, request
PRODUCT_TYPES and read `productType` in `purchaseLinesDetails`.

typePurchaseLineCandidate.description:
A purchase line in the older format, with a single value for each field. Use
PurchaseLine instead: it has candidates with confidence levels for each field.

content.description: The decoded text of the QR code.

typeQrCodeData.description: A QR code found in the document, returned for the QR_CODES feature.

street.description: The street name, without the house number.

countryCode.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capital letters, for example "DK".

typeStructuredAddress.description: An address split into its parts. All fields are empty when the address can't be resolved.

version.description: The version of the Swiss QR bill standard, always "0200".

account.description: The IBAN or QR-IBAN of the creditor.

creditorAddressType.description: The format of the creditor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.

creditorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the creditor, or the first address line.

creditorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the creditor, or the second address line.

creditorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the creditor.

creditorAddressCountry.description: The country of the creditor, as a two-letter code.

ultimateCreditorAddressType.description:
The format of the ultimate creditor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.
Empty when the bill names no ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorName.description: The name of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the ultimate creditor, or the first address line.

ultimateCreditorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the ultimate creditor, or the second address line.

ultimateCreditorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressCity.description: The town of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressCountry.description: The country of the ultimate creditor, as a two-letter code.

amount.description: The amount to pay, for example "1949.75". Empty when the bill leaves the amount open.

ultimateDebtorAddressType.description:
The format of the ultimate debtor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.
Empty when the bill names no ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorName.description: The name of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the ultimate debtor, or the first address line.

ultimateDebtorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the ultimate debtor, or the second address line.

ultimateDebtorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressCity.description: The town of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressCountry.description: The country of the ultimate debtor, as a two-letter code.

paymentReferenceType.description:
The reference type: "QRR" for a QR reference, "SCOR" for a creditor reference, or
"NON" for no reference.

unstructuredMessage.description: Additional information for the payment, for example "Order from 15.10.2020".

trailer.description: The end of the payment data, always "EPD".

billingInformation.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Billing information isn't extracted yet, so this is always empty.

av1Parameters.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Alternative procedure parameters aren't extracted yet, so this is
always empty.

av2Parameters.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Alternative procedure parameters aren't extracted yet, so this is
always empty.

typeSwissQrBill.description:
A Swiss QR bill parsed from a QR code in the document, returned for the
SWISS_QR_BILLS feature. Only QR codes that follow version 0200 of the Swiss QR bill
standard are returned. The fields hold the values of the QR code as they are.

property.description: Additional information detected for the symbol.

text.description: The actual UTF-8 representation of the symbol.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the symbol. Range [0, 1].

text.description: UTF-8 text detected on the pages.

typeTextAnnotation.description:
The OCR output for a document: its text, and its structure from pages down to single
symbols (TextAnnotation, Page, Block, Paragraph, Word, Symbol). Each element from Page
down can have properties, such as the detected languages and breaks.

typeTier.description:
The model tier that processes the document. When no tier is set, PREMIUM is used.

 - DEFAULT: No tier set. The document is processed as PREMIUM.
 - STANDARD: The older tier, kept for existing integrations. Use PREMIUM for new integrations.
 - PREMIUM: Our proprietary AI, and the tier used when no tier is set.
 - ULTRA: Combines our proprietary AI with reasoning LLMs for the highest available quality.
Only available through Smartscan Async. The synchronous API serves it as PREMIUM.

pageRef.description: The page the VAT level was found on, starting at 1.

percentage.description:
Candidates for the VAT rate, as a percentage with a dot as the decimal separator,
for example "25.0".

totalInclVat.description: Candidates for the amount including VAT at this rate.

totalExclVat.description: Candidates for the amount excluding VAT that the VAT is based on.

totalVat.description: Candidates for the VAT amount at this rate.

typeVatDistribution.description: A VAT level, with a list of candidates for each field.

percentage.description: The VAT rate, as a percentage with a dot as the decimal separator, for example "25.0".

amount.description: The VAT amount at this rate, rounded to two decimals, for example "585.45".

pageRef.description: The page the VAT level was found on, starting at 1.

exclVat.description: The amount excluding VAT that the VAT is based on, for example "2341.80".

inclVat.description: The amount including VAT at this rate, for example "2926.25".

typeVatDistributionCandidate.description:
A VAT level in the older format, with a single value for each field. Use
VatDistribution instead: it has candidates with confidence levels for each field.

typeVertex.description: A point on the page, in pixel coordinates.

property.description: Additional information detected for the word.

symbols.description:
List of symbols in the word.
The order of the symbols follows the natural reading order.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the word. Range [0, 1].

document.description:
The document to process. Send the file Base64-encoded in content, or a URL in
source.httpUri for the service to download. When both are set, content is used.

tags.description:
Labels for the transaction. To delete every transaction with a tag, call
DELETE /v1/tags/{tagName}.

features.description:
The features to extract, for example TOTAL_INCL_VAT or PURCHASE_LINES. Names are
case-sensitive; see the [feature list](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/smartscan-async/features/).
An unknown name returns 400. Required unless questions are set. PRODUCT_TYPES also turns
on PURCHASE_LINES, and VERIFIED turns on the features it verifies.

customId.description:
Your own ID for the transaction, to get its status and results, or delete it, without
keeping the transaction ID. It must be unique in your project: reusing one returns
409 Conflict until that transaction has been deleted.

questions.description:
Questions to ask about the document. The answers come back in the QA annotation, in
answerCandidates. Setting questions turns on the QA feature.

v1CreateTransactionRequest.description: Request body for creating a transaction.

id.description:
The transaction ID. Use it to get the status and results, to send feedback and to
delete the transaction.

customId.description: The custom ID from the request, if you set one.

content.description:
The bytes of the file, base64-encoded in JSON. If you send both `content` and
`source`, `content` is used.

source.description: Where to download the document from, when you don't send `content`.

v1Document.description: A document to scan: a PDF or an image. Send either `content` or `source`.

httpUri.description:
A public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the document. The server must use port 80 or 443,
answer with HTTP 200 and a Content-Length header, and send at most 10 MiB.
POST /v1/document:annotate waits 2 seconds for it, and async transactions wait 10
seconds. When the download fails, the call returns 400.

v1DocumentSource.description: A location to download a document from.

annotations.description:
The results, one entry per feature that produced any. Empty while the transaction is
CREATED or RUNNING, and when it FAILED. Features that failed or found nothing are left
out. PRODUCT_TYPES and VERIFIED have no entry of their own: they add productType to the
purchase lines and the VERIFIED confidence level to candidates.

errorMessage.description:
Describes a feature that failed, for example "image too large". Set when the transaction
is FAILED or PARTIAL.

customId.description: The custom ID, if one was set when the transaction was created.

status.description:
The processing status. CREATED: accepted and waiting to be processed. RUNNING: being
processed. DONE: every requested feature finished. PARTIAL: processing finished, but some
features failed while others succeeded, and the results hold the ones that succeeded.
FAILED: every feature failed. DONE, PARTIAL and FAILED are final.

errorMessage.description:
Describes a feature that failed, for example "failed to process pdf". Set as soon as any
feature has failed, so always when the status is PARTIAL or FAILED.

customId.description:
The custom ID, if one was set when the transaction was created. Left out when
errorMessage is set.
The custom ID, if one was set when the transaction was created.

v2ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence level of a product type candidate, from VERY_LOW to VERY_HIGH. UNKNOWN means the
model gave no level.

v2ProductType.description:
The product types a text can be classified into. UNDEFINED isn't a product type: it's the
empty value.

type.description:
The product type, such as ACCOUNTING_SOFTWARE. It's left out when the model returns a
label that has no product type.

label.description: The product type's name in words, such as "Accounting software".

confidence.description:
The model's confidence score for this candidate. Use confidenceLevel to decide whether to
trust it.

v2ProductTypeCandidate.description: A product type candidate for a text.
